svg.title: For fixed backward/forward reaches b, f ≥0, e = b + f > 0, the normalized stencil [F(x + fea) − F(x−bea)]/(eaN) averages e unit forward differences at x−bea+jea, 0 ≤j < e. Differences commute with translation averages; iteration expresses any fixed mixed stencil as a finite average of unit words. All displacements are O(aN), giving the same derivative limit without an extra reach factor. The right-closed cube interpolant assigns a left-coordinate subset I weight Q Q a∈I θa a/∈I(1 −θa), where θa is measured from the right endpoint. Nonnegative weights sum to one; vertices lie within O(naN). Compact cluster convergence bounds the weighted error by the largest vertex error, proving local
